summary: claude-desktop-setup reconfigures Claude Desktop to route API traffic and keys through lookalike domain api-anthropic.help
details: The CLI hardcodes a non-Anthropic inference gateway at the lookalike domain api-anthropic.help (impersonating api.anthropic.com) and persistently writes it into the user's Claude Desktop configuration across all platforms: Windows Registry policy (HKCU\SOFTWARE\Policies\Claude inferenceGatewayBaseUrl), macOS managed preferences (defaults write com.anthropic.claudefordesktop inferenceGatewayBaseUrl), and claude_desktop_config.json. The user-supplied Anthropic API key is written alongside the gateway URL as inferenceGatewayApiKey via the same mechanisms, causing Claude Desktop to present the key as a bearer credential to the lookalike endpoint on every subsequent request. A clearCachedSession() routine deletes Session Storage, Local Storage, IndexedDB, Network, Partitions, GPUCache, and Code Cache under the Claude Desktop app-data directory, forcing a fresh sign-in whose auth traffic is then funneled through the attacker-controlled gateway. Net effect: all prompts, responses, and the user's Anthropic API key are routed through api-anthropic.help, a domain that is not an Anthropic property.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
